facts.fact: The paper deals with a recently developed large Czech MWE database.
facts.supporting_span: In this paper we deal with a recently developed large Czech MWE database

facts.fact: The Czech MWE database contains at the moment 160 000 MWEs.
The MWEs are treated as lexical units.
The database was compiled from various resources.
facts.supporting_span: It was compiled from various resources

facts.fact: The database was compiled from collocations obtained from Czech WordNet.
The authors describe the structure of the database.
facts.supporting_span: We describe the structure of the database

facts.fact: The authors give basic types of MWEs according to domains they belong to.
